tenant_boundary.rule: company_id is the sole canonical tenant/company boundary; legacy tenant identifiers MUST be normalized before packet construction and MUST NOT appear as independent authority boundaries.

authority_rule: DecisionPacket represents analysis and recommendation. It MUST NOT grant permission, entitlement, identity, ownership, approval, financial authority, policy authority, or execution authority.
cross_domain_rule: Domain-specific data belongs in typed extension_data and references canonical packet entities by stable IDs; it must not redefine company_id, authority semantics, evidence provenance, ranking semantics, or recommendation authority.
invariants: packet_id is globally stable for one packet revision lineage.
Every packet has exactly one company_id.
domain classifies context; it does not confer authority.
All references to options/evidence/objectives resolve within the packet or through explicit external_refs.
Recommendation references an option or an explicit non-action recommendation type.
Authority requirements describe prerequisites only; governed execution owns authorization and execution.
Evidence provenance is preserved independently of conclusions.
Packet revisions are append-only/superseding; historical packet content is not silently rewritten.
Unknown domain-specific fields are isolated under extension_data.
